description: This file defines the SyncCallback interface for handling synchronization events in the application, including default implementation details.

classes.name: SyncCallback
classes.description: Interface for synchronizing callbacks with methods for various sync events, and an embedded companion object with a default implementation.

methods.name: onSyncProgress
methods.description: Called to report progress messages during sync.

methods.name: onSyncError
methods.description: Called when an error occurs during sync.

methods.name: onSyncConflict
methods.description: Called when a sync conflict occurs, with a resolution function to choose between local and remote versions.
